title: Equidimensionality after polynomial extension and localization
statement: Let $(C,\mathfrak n)$ be a Noetherian local ring such that $\operatorname{Spec}(C)$ is equidimensional, and let $\mathfrak n'\subset C[x_1,\ldots,x_r]$ be a maximal ideal lying over $\mathfrak n$. If $C$ is complete, then $C[x_1,\ldots,x_r]_{\mathfrak n'}$ is catenary and its spectrum is equidimensional; every irreducible component has dimension $\dim C+r$.
